args.CodeContent:
# Deployment Plan: Push to GitHub & Deploy to Vercel/Render

This plan details how to push the AI Investment Research Agent codebase to GitHub and deploy it. 

We highlight a key technical challenge: the backend uses a LangGraph-based research agent (calling Gemini & Tavily APIs, fetching financial data), which typically takes 15–40 seconds to run. The **Vercel Hobby (free) plan has a strict 10-second serverless execution timeout**, meaning the backend would fail with 504 Gateway Timeouts if deployed on Vercel. 

Therefore, we recommend:
1. **Frontend**: Deploy static React/Vite app on **Vercel** (free).
2. **Backend**: Deploy persistent Express app on **Render** (free tier) or **Railway**.
3. **Database**: Deploy PostgreSQL database on **Neon** or **Supabase** (free tier) to persist reports.

---

## User Review Required

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Vercel Serverless Timeout Warning**
> Deploying the Node.js backend to Vercel Serverless Functions will likely result in `504 Gateway Timeout` errors when running research queries. This is because Vercel's Hobby (free) plan restricts serverless executions to **10 seconds**. The LangGraph research agent needs 15–40 seconds to search web pages, fetch Yahoo Finance statistics, and reason using Google Gemini.
> 
> **Recommended Solution:**
> - Deploy the **Frontend** to Vercel (static web app hosting).
> - Deploy the **Backend** to Render or Railway (continuous container runner with no timeout limits).
> - Deploy a free PostgreSQL database (e.g. on Neon, Supabase, or Render) for backend report persistence.

---

## Open Questions

- **Do you want to proceed with the recommended architecture (Frontend on Vercel, Backend on Render/Railway, Database on Neon/Supabase)?**
- **Do you have your GitHub login/credentials already authorized on this PC?** If not, the `git push` command might prompt you for authorization in your browser or require a Personal Access Token (PAT).

---

## Proposed Changes

### [Root Directory]

Creating a root-level `.gitignore` file to ensure we do not push sensitive keys (`.env`), database state files (`db.json`), or massive package folders (`node_modules`) to GitHub.

#### [NEW] [.gitignore](file:///c:/Users/ASUS/OneDrive/Desktop/AI%20Investment%20Research%20Agent/.gitignore)
Create a `.gitignore` file at the root containing:
```gitignore
node_modules/
backend/node_modules/
frontend/node_modules/
frontend/dist/
backend/.env
.env
backend/db.json
db.json
ai_investment_research_agent.zip
logs/
*.log
.vscode/
.DS_Store
```

---

## Verification Plan

### Pushing Code to GitHub
1. Initialize local git repository in `c:\Users\ASUS\OneDrive\Desktop\AI Investment Research Agent`.
2. Add all files except those in `.gitignore`.
3. Commit with message: `feat: initial commit of AI Investment Research Agent`.
4. Add remote `origin` pointing to `https://github.com/PJAYANTH2006/AI_Investement_System.git`.
5. Run `git push -u origin main`.

### Step-by-Step Deployment Guides

We will provide full step-by-step guides for:
1. **Setting up the Database (Neon/Supabase)**
2. **Deploying the Backend (Render)**
3. **Deploying the Frontend (Vercel)**
4. **Connecting them together via Environment Variables**

# Deployment Walkthrough & Step-by-Step Guide

The codebase has been prepared, committed, and successfully pushed to your GitHub repository:
👉 **Repository**: [https://github.com/PJAYANTH2006/AI_Investement_System.git](https://github.com/PJAYANTH2006/AI_Investement_System.git)

---

## 🛠️ Code Changes Made

To prepare for production, we made the following changes:
1. **[NEW] [root .gitignore](file:///c:/Users/ASUS/OneDrive/Desktop/AI%20Investment%20Research%20Agent/.gitignore)**: Configured to ignore `node_modules`, local database files (`db.json`), secrets (`.env`), and zipped files.
2. **[MODIFY] [App.jsx](file:///c:/Users/ASUS/OneDrive/Desktop/AI%20Investment%20Research%20Agent/frontend/src/App.jsx)**: Updated API requests to prepend `import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL || ''`. This allows the static frontend on Vercel to dynamically point to the backend server in production, while falling back to relative paths in local development.

---

## 🚀 Step-by-Step Deployment Process

Since the LangGraph research agent takes 15–40 seconds to query Google Gemini, search the web with Tavily, and scrape finance pages, **it will time out on Vercel's Hobby (free) plan (10-second limit)**. 

Follow this three-step process to deploy the system correctly using free tiers:

### Step 1: Set up a PostgreSQL Database (Neon or Supabase)

To store research reports in production, you need a cloud-hosted PostgreSQL database. We recommend **Neon** (highly optimized for serverless) or **Supabase**.

#### Option A: Neon (Recommended)
1. Go to [Neon.tech](https://neon.tech/) and sign up.
2. Create a new project named `ai-investment-research`.
3. In your dashboard, copy the **Connection String** (select `Node.js` or standard connection string).
   - *Example:* `postgresql://neondb_owner:password@ep-cool-butterfly-a5.us-east-2.aws.neon.tech/neondb?sslmode=require`
4. Keep this connection URL handy; this is your `DATABASE_URL`.

#### Option B: Supabase
1. Go to [Supabase.com](https://supabase.com/) and create a project.
2. Go to **Project Settings** > **Database** and copy the URI under **Connection String** > **URI**.
3. Replace the placeholder password with your actual database password. This is your `DATABASE_URL`.

---

### Step 2: Deploy the Backend on Render

**Render** allows running persistent Express Node.js servers for free, with no execution timeout limits.

1. Go to [Render.com](https://render.com/) and log in using your GitHub account.
2. Click **New +** > **Web Service**.
3. Connect your repository: `AI_Investement_System`.
4. Configure the Web Service settings:
   - **Name**: `ai-investment-backend`
   - **Region**: Choose the closest region to you.
   - **Branch**: `main`
   - **Root Directory**: `backend`
   - **Runtime**: `Node`
   - **Build Command**: `npm install`
   - **Start Command**: `npm start`
5. Scroll down and click **Advanced** > **Add Environment Variable** to add the following variables:
   | Key | Value | Description |
   | :--- | :--- | :--- |
   | `GOOGLE_API_KEY` | *Your Gemini API Key* | Required for LLM analysis |
   | `TAVILY_API_KEY` | *Your Tavily API Key* | Required for real-time web search |
   | `DATABASE_URL` | *Your Connection String from Step 1* | Connection string for PostgreSQL database |
   | `NODE_ENV` | `production` | Sets server environment |
6. Click **Deploy Web Service**.
7. Once deployed, Render will provide a public URL (e.g. `https://ai-investment-backend.onrender.com`). Copy this URL; you will need it for the frontend.

---

### Step 3: Deploy the Frontend on Vercel

**Vercel** is the best place to host static Vite/React frontends.

1. Go to [Vercel.com](https://vercel.com/) and log in using your GitHub account.
2. Click **Add New** > **Project**.
3. Import the `AI_Investement_System` repository.
4. In the configuration window, configure the following settings:
   - **Framework Preset**: `Vite`
   - **Root Directory**: Click *Edit* and select the **`frontend`** folder.
   - **Build and Development Settings**: Keep defaults (`npm run build` and `dist`).
5. Open the **Environment Variables** accordion and add:
   | Key | Value | Description |
   | :--- | :--- | :--- |
   | `VITE_API_URL` | `https://ai-investment-backend.onrender.com` | **The URL of your deployed Render backend (from Step 2)** |
6. Click **Deploy**.
7. Vercel will build the frontend and provide a public URL for your dashboard (e.g., `https://ai-investment-system.vercel.app`).

---

## ✅ Verification Checklist

Once all three pieces are deployed:
1. Open your Vercel URL.
2. Enter your password to log in.
3. Submit a company name to research.
4. Monitor the Render backend logs (in your Render Dashboard) to see the LangGraph agent executing.
5. Verify that once completed, the report is saved to PostgreSQL and loaded successfully on the React dashboard interface.
